races.name: Racing To School Reaches 25 Years Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Minella Blizzard
runners_data.note: Pulled up on Irish point debut but connections may know more than the form suggests about this lightly-raced newcomer
runners_data.comment: Out of a well-connected mare but was pulled up on his Irish point debut in April
runners_data.spotlight: Out of a well-connected mare but was pulled up on his Irish point debut in April; the betting market may guide on this rules debut.

runners_data.name: Loriko
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won last time at Taunton and handles good ground well based on similar-going record of 5/7
runners_data.comment: Does not have entirely convincing profile but won a match last month; strong claims
runners_data.spotlight: Well below the fairly useful form he showed in the autumn when beaten odds-on favourite in Plumpton maiden (2m, good) in April but made amends when winning tactical match race at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) last month; his profile is still not entirely convincing but he has strong claims here.

runners_data.name: Biggles
runners_data.note: Useful ex-Flat horse returning from 747-day absence with significant questions about fitness and hurdling ability
runners_data.spotlight: Very useful on the Flat in his prime, with career highlight his 2023 Bunbury Cup success (7f; unraced beyond about 1m); absent since two below-par runs in spring 2024, though, and tricky to weigh up on stable/hurdle debut.

runners_data.name: White Riot
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who shapes to get ideal tactical scenario with uncontested lead throughout
runners_data.comment: Bumper winner; not much has gone to plan over hurdles but he still enters calculations
runners_data.spotlight: Won good-ground bumper by 8l in March 2025; rather disappointing when well-held third on hurdle debut in October and has failed to complete twice since but shaped with promise before weakening and falling at Southwell (2m, good) last month, after a break.

runners_data.name: Starshine Legend
runners_data.note: Hold-up style on good ground but failed to complete last time and faces fitness concerns after inconsistent spring form
runners_data.comment: Fair Flat racer; not at best since long absence but still considered on hurdle debut
runners_data.spotlight: Fair Flat racer who gained his win over 1m4f two years ago; back from long layoff with two underwhelming runs for new stable this spring but still has possibilities if he takes well to hurdling at the first attempt.

races.paceDynamic: White Riot is the only confirmed pace-setter in this small field, likely to get an uncontested lead from flag to finish. With three hold-up horses (Loriko, Biggles, Starshine Legend) and one unknown quantity (Minella Blizzard), White Riot will dictate terms throughout the 2-mile trip. The lack of pace pressure means he can control fractions and kick when ready, while the hold-up brigade face the challenge of giving away lengths early to a horse who has already shown front-running ability. This race shape strongly favours the leader White Riot, as sustainable fractions and no pace pressure create ideal conditions for wire-to-wire tactics.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: White Riot Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If White Riot gets an easy lead and maintains rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: He sets comfortable fractions unchallenged and has enough left to repel late challenges from the hold-up horses. The lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate terms perfectly for his front-running style.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses can close the gap turning for home
scenarios.body: Loriko or Starshine Legend produce strong late runs to overhaul White Riot in the final furlong. Their class advantage tells when White Riot's stamina gives way after making all the running.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Biggles Class Shows
scenarios.trigger: If the ex-Flat performer handles the hurdles smoothly
scenarios.body: His superior ability on the level translates to hurdling success as he settles behind White Riot before asserting his quality. The good ground suits his proven Flat form perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Minella Blizzard Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the newcomer shows significant improvement from his point debut
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced runner benefits from the educational run and produces a shock performance. His unknown ability level could be significantly higher than his pulled-up debut suggests.

watchPoints.text: White Riot's jumping under pressure - has failed to complete twice since hurdle debut and any mistake could prove costly
Biggles in the betting market - his 747-day absence makes fitness a major concern despite his previous Flat ability
Minella Blizzard's early position - if he shows more pace than expected it could disrupt White Riot's tactical advantage
Loriko's jumping rhythm - needs to settle well behind the pace to produce his characteristic late kick
Overall pace through the first mile - if White Riot goes too slowly it could set up perfectly for the hold-up horses

races.name: JAL Roofing Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Millena Agent
runners_data.note: Lightly raced hold-up type with 61 days off, pedigree suggests this trip will suit but inexperienced over hurdles.
runners_data.comment: Only 1-11 in points, but best effort since her heavy-ground maiden win last time out.
runners_data.spotlight: 2m4f Hexham maiden point winner last November (heavy), and best effort since when second in her members latest; some encouragement for staying trips on pedigree (family of Monger Lane), and won't mind any rain.

runners_data.name: Stavanger Rose
runners_data.note: Accident-prone hold-up runner, 12 days since last run, needs everything to fall right from the back but has shown glimpses.
runners_data.comment: Has ability, but failed to see out 2m6f when finally registering completion latest.
runners_data.spotlight: Accident prone during her time with Daisy Hitchins, albeit shaping with promise sometimes; failed to see out 2m6f when finally registering a completion on stable debut latest, however.

runners_data.name: Up The Hill
runners_data.note: Must settle better than in bumpers, gains tongue-tie which should help, but 98 days off is a concern for sharpness.
runners_data.comment: Bred to need a trip and hurdles, but needs to settle better than she did in bumpers.
runners_data.spotlight: Bred to appreciate a trip and hurdles, but must settle an awful lot better than on either bumper start last winter; gains tongue-tie.

runners_data.name: Coumeenoole
runners_data.note: Class horse with prominent style, only 27 days off, tongue-tie retained, strong recent form gives him clear claims.
runners_data.comment: Close second in a Market Rasen 0-125 last time out (3m, good) sets the standard.
runners_data.spotlight: Miles clear with one other when beaten just over 1l in a Market Rasen 0-125 handicap latest (3m, good; RPR 118), and this novice contest isn't anywhere near as deep; yet to register form of that calibre with give underfoot, but possible he could get away with it here even if rain arrives.

runners_data.name: Presentandcorrect
runners_data.note: Uncontested leader with good recent hurdles debut, 12 days off keeps him sharp, tactical advantage is crucial.
runners_data.comment: Kept on into a near-4l third on Cartmel hurdles debut latest (2m6f, good); handles cut.
runners_data.spotlight: 23l clear of Stavanger Rose when third at Cartmel on last month's hurdling debut (2m6f, good), beaten about 4l but quite strong in the finish; coped fine with cut in bumpers and argues a solid case.

runners_data.name: Executive Producer
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who weakened late last time, headgear changes suggest connections seeking improvement but trip may stretch him.
runners_data.comment: Much better effort when fourth here latest, albeit not seeing out 2m4f; up in trip.
runners_data.spotlight: Big uplift on previous hurdling efforts when 15l fourth over 2m4f here latest (good), though late weakening doesn't necessarily augur well for this step up in trip (didn't see out 3m in Irish points).

races.paceDynamic: Presentandcorrect is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely setting a measured tempo over this staying trip with no early pressure. Coumeenoole and potentially Millena Agent will track prominently behind the leader, while the majority of the field (Stavanger Rose, Up The Hill, Executive Producer) are hold-up horses who need the race to come to them. With one uncontested leader and multiple closers, this sets up a tactical race where Presentandcorrect can control the fractions and kick clear when ready. This pace dynamic strongly favours prominent runners and the leader, as the hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground if Presentandcorrect times his move correctly.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Soft Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Presentandcorrect gets easy fractions and no early pressure from the field.
scenarios.body: The confirmed front-runner can dictate perfect fractions and kick clear when ready, leaving the hold-up horses with too much to do in the straight. With his strong finish at Cartmel over a similar trip, Presentandcorrect can exploit this tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Early
scenarios.trigger: If Coumeenoole or Millena Agent press forward early to challenge Presentandcorrect.
scenarios.body: This creates a stronger gallop that could expose Presentandcorrect's stamina reserves while setting up the race for the hold-up horses to close late. The pace becomes more genuine, suiting those who need time to wind up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is extremely slow and bunches the field for a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The closers get their ideal scenario with a crawling pace that brings stamina less into play and emphasises speed from the back. However, this seems unlikely given the distance and lack of early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Presentandcorrect and early leaders tire dramatically in the final half-mile.
scenarios.body: The stay-on types benefit from a strong early gallop that finds out the front-runners, though this requires an unlikely pace collapse. Limited depth in this small field makes a complete front-end meltdown improbable.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Coumeenoole or Millena Agent go forward early to pressure Presentandcorrect as this completely changes the race dynamic.
Monitor Up The Hill's early settling with the tongue-tie fitted as his bumper form shows he can be very keen.
Track Executive Producer's position turning in as his late weakening last time over a shorter trip raises stamina doubts here.
Watch for any jumping errors from Stavanger Rose given her accident-prone record with previous trainer.
Observe how quickly Presentandcorrect kicks clear as his tactical advantage depends on timing his move correctly.

races.name: Nourkrin Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Tiger Orchid
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits if pace is strong, solid recent form for current connections, good going fine, 16 days ideal preparation
runners_data.comment: Hasn't held on to any winning opportunity lately; chance off unchanged mark even so.
runners_data.spotlight: Four good efforts from as many starts for current connections, though once again wasn't quite able to convert a winning opportunity at Huntingdon latest (3m1f, good to firm); fair claims off an unchanged mark, and ought to cope with any rain.

runners_data.name: Secret Trix
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with highest RPR rating, proven course winner off higher mark, Sean Bowen booking significant
runners_data.comment: C&D exploits include a win off 9lb higher (soft) and last month's 0-145 third; player.
runners_data.spotlight: C&D record of 31133 includes a soft-ground win off 9lb higher almost two years ago and last month's perfectly serviceable staying-on 10l third in 0-145 company; faces an easier-looking task this afternoon.

runners_data.name: Belvedere Blast
runners_data.note: Hold-up type needing miracle June form, 158-day absence major concern despite historical June success record
runners_data.comment: ?rip and time of year both in his favour; not absolutely certain to be at his best fresh.
runners_data.spotlight: Five out of seven hurdles wins have been recorded in the month of June; mark and trip fine, but although once a winner after 151 days out his record following an absence is a bit mixed overall.

runners_data.name: Noble Birth
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with consistency issues, stable debut disappointing over longer trip, others more reliable
runners_data.comment: Didn't see out 3m6f on April's stable debut; more in his favour here, but others likelier.
runners_data.spotlight: Wanted for consistency towards the end of his time with Gavin Cromwell, and didn't see out 3m6f on April's stable debut; more in his favour here, but others more persuasive.

runners_data.name: Mammies Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who hangs left, recent Exeter third encouraging, proven three-mile winner suits extended distance
runners_data.comment: Hung left again when beaten 2l latest but late mistake more the issue; tries new trip.
runners_data.spotlight: Despite again hanging left may have gone closer than a 2l third at Exeter latest (2m6f, good) but for whacking two out; stayers' trip asks a new question, but some appeal whilst still just below a winning mark.

runners_data.name: Breezethroughlife
runners_data.note: Prominent racer perfectly positioned if leaders set honest gallop, disappointing recent form over shorter trips
runners_data.comment: Doncaster second last December (3m), but not seen out this or shorter trips well since.
runners_data.spotlight: December's Doncaster second (3m, good to soft) suggested a sound future as a stayer, so it's disappointing he has not always seen out mostly shorter trips since, beaten 26l over almost 2m5f latest.

runners_data.name: Faded Fantasy
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with amateur jockey, three good-ground wins in 2025, 141-day break never overcome before
runners_data.comment: Profitable 2025, but currently 9lb above his last winning mark; might just need this.
runners_data.spotlight: Three good-ground wins at up to 3m2f during a profitable 2025, all off at least 9lb lower; yet to defy a break in excess of 45 days, so absence since January cannot rate a plus.

runners_data.name: Top Coeur
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse not seeing out races this year, beaten 54 lengths latest over shorter trip here
runners_data.comment: 54l last of eight here latest (2m4f); looks the least compelling of the Williams pair.
runners_data.spotlight: Not seeing out his races at all convincingly this year, beaten 54l in a 2m4f 0-125 handicap here latest (2m4f, good); overlooked.

races.paceDynamic: Faded Fantasy will take them along at a sustainable pace with Breezethroughlife likely to race prominently in second. With seven hold-up horses behind them, the early tempo should be manageable rather than fierce, allowing the leaders to dictate terms through the middle stages. The real test comes after the last hurdle when the hold-up brigade unleash their finishing kicks, but the extended trip and gentle early gallop should favour those who can sustain their effort from the front rather than find a sudden burst. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent racers and front runners who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably unfold behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Favours Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Faded Fantasy and Breezethroughlife are allowed to bowl along unchallenged through halfway.
scenarios.body: The gentle early tempo preserves their stamina reserves for a strong gallop from three out, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up significant ground in the closing stages. Those racing handy avoid the inevitable traffic problems that emerge when seven closers all seek racing room simultaneously.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Quality
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and sets up a sprint finish from the last hurdle.
scenarios.body: Secret Trix and Tiger Orchid, both proven at this level with superior ratings, can unleash telling finishing kicks that overwhelm the front runners. The class differential becomes decisive when the race reaches its climax.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mammies Boy Stays Strongest
scenarios.trigger: If the sustained gallop from three out develops into a true stamina test.
scenarios.body: His recent Exeter third showed renewed form, and Nick Scholfield's charge can grind past tiring leaders in the final furlong when superior staying power becomes paramount. The extended trip plays perfectly into his hands as a proven three-mile performer.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Belvedere Blast June Magic
scenarios.trigger: If Adrian Keatley's runner overcomes his 158-day absence and reproduces his remarkable June record.
scenarios.body: His five wins from seven in this month suggest something special happens with his preparation for June targets. The long break becomes irrelevant if his seasonal pattern holds true.

watchPoints.text: Faded Fantasy could compound if amateur jockey gets carried away in front and sets unsustainable fractions
Traffic problems likely in straight when seven hold-up horses all seek racing room simultaneously
Belvedere Blast's 158-day absence may prove insurmountable despite his remarkable June winning record
Mammies Boy's tendency to hang left could cause interference issues in a competitive finish
Secret Trix and Tiger Orchid carry the class but need the pace to develop properly to showcase finishing kicks

races.name: JMI Planning 10 Years In Business Mares' Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Regal Renaissance
runners_data.note: Hold-up style disadvantaged in small field but brings highest class level and proven stamina over three miles
runners_data.comment: Signed off for Henry Daly with 2m4f Ludlow win last month; strong claims on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: 2-13 over fences when trained by Henry Daly, the latter win gained at Ludlow (2m4f, good) last month; yet fully to convince stamina-wise over 3m but, having recently changed hands for £22,000, still has strong claims on this stable debut.

runners_data.name: I Am The Moon
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with chasing struggles but won last hurdles start and gets significant weight relief
runners_data.comment: Failed to convince in two chasing attempts last term; ran just okay over hurdles recently
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to convince as a chaser in two attempts at last season; subsequently won over hurdles (2m3f, soft) but her form dipped afterwards; took step back in right direction when well-held second in four-runner hurdle last month (3m2f, good to firm) but needs another on this return to fences.

runners_data.name: That's Nice
runners_data.note: Likely leader whose novice chase form disappoints despite strong hurdling background for Henderson
runners_data.comment: 2-3 over hurdles; 0-5 and generally disappointing over fences but drops in grade today
runners_data.spotlight: 2-3 as a novice hurdler during 2024-25 season but 0-5 and generally disappointing since switched to chasing in November; didn't run badly when third of four in higher-grade event here (2m4f, good) last month, though, and is still unexposed over this sort of trip.

runners_data.name: Queens Wish
runners_data.note: Proven three-mile winner who needs to bounce back from poor Cheltenham effort but suits conditions
runners_data.comment: Didn't fire on last outing but was in fair form beforehand and is back on her winning mark
runners_data.spotlight: 1-10 for current stable over the last year, the win gained off today's mark at Southwell (3m, good to soft) in November; needs to bounce back from a disappointing effort over that C&D last month but ran quite well in a valuable series final two starts ago and is of interest here.

races.paceDynamic: That's Nice will likely lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners in this small field. I Am The Moon and Queens Wish will track prominently behind, creating a sustainable gallop over three miles. The pace should be manageable early, allowing for tactical positioning, but will intensify from three out as the prominently-raced horses begin their challenges. This measured tempo strongly favours prominent racers who can position handy and kick from the front group, while hold-up horse Regal Renaissance faces a significant tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Power Play
scenarios.trigger: If That's Nice and I Am The Moon maintain forward positions without over-racing
scenarios.body: The controlled gallop allows both to conserve energy for sustained challenges from two out, negating Regal Renaissance's finishing kick. Queens Wish and either leader can dominate the finish having saved ground in the prominent positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio go too hard early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: Regal Renaissance benefits from the pace collapse, swooping late under Sean Bowen's patient ride. The class edge shows as the others weaken, though he still needs luck in running in a small field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Queens Wish Redemption
scenarios.trigger: If Queens Wish gets the perfect trip tracking the pace
scenarios.body: Her previous course form and stamina reserves prove decisive in a staying test. The weight advantage tells in the final furlong as she outbattles the others who've done more work.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If That's Nice goes too fast and the field spreads out dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test rather than tactical battle, favouring whoever conserves most energy. Form goes out the window as it becomes about who handles the pace stress best.

watchPoints.text: That's Nice going too fast early as the likely leader could compromise the entire field's finishing efforts
Regal Renaissance getting shuffled back too far in the small field where passing opportunities are limited
I Am The Moon's jumping under pressure given her previous chasing struggles when the pace lifts
Queens Wish's ability to handle any increased tempo after her stamina-sapping Cheltenham run
The pace from the second circuit as the prominent trio will dictate whether this becomes a staying test

races.name: Litholexal Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Hillsin
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose consistency has deserted him but drops back to winning mark from October
runners_data.comment: No longer as consistent as two summers ago, though he's back on a winning mark, at least.
runners_data.spotlight: The consistency of his summer 2024 campaign has long deserted him, the return to the mark of October's Exeter win (2m2f, good to firm) owed to three poor runs since; others convince more.

runners_data.name: The Best Way
runners_data.note: Strong closer who won last start at Newcastle and shaped much better than finishing position at Hexham
runners_data.comment: 31l third on comeback run was better than the bare facts; chance if staying 2m4f now.
runners_data.spotlight: Determined last-gasp Newcastle winner in February 2025 (2m1f, good to soft), and recent Hexham third on sole run since was much more promising than the 31l distance beaten might imply (rallied after late blunder); may be a case of whether this longer trip is within range now.

runners_data.name: Saxon Cross
runners_data.note: Hold-up type getting handy initial mark after promising novice fourth here last month
runners_data.comment: Just behind a next-time winner when a staying-on fourth here latest (2m); useful mark.
runners_data.spotlight: Last month's staying-on 5l fourth in a 2m novice here was given a boost by the third at Southwell two days ago; handy initial mark set against his bumper best; kept almost exclusively to good ground so far.

runners_data.name: Bells Of Ufford
runners_data.note: Another closer but significant 70-day absence is concerning despite retaining cheekpieces
runners_data.comment: Yet to fare significantly better since cheekpieces went on; won't want appreciable rain.
runners_data.spotlight: Consolidated rather than improved upon previous best efforts during last season, despite the addition of cheekpieces; remains on a tempting mark, but significant rain wouldn't be welcomed.

runners_data.name: Pepite De Saphir
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter wearing tongue-tie but showed little on debut for current connections
runners_data.spotlight: Career already subject to two significant interruptions, and offered little in a debuted tongue-tie when starting out for current connections here last month (2m7f, good).

runners_data.name: Brionywells
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in career-best form after eight-month layoff, won well at Worcester last week
runners_data.comment: Worcester 2m7f winner last week (good) following eight months out; chance despite penalty.
runners_data.spotlight: Major personal best on last week's return from eight months out, staying on well late to take a 2m7f Worcester novice handicap (good); little to choose between her peak previous RPRs with or without cut, so possible she'll cope if the rain arrives; chance despite the penalty.

runners_data.name: The Padster
runners_data.note: Prominent runner wearing cheekpieces for second time, needs good or faster ground ideally
runners_data.comment: Second at Hereford latest (2m3f), albeit beaten 21l; untried on ground slower than good.
runners_data.spotlight: Back on track to an extent with last month's fast-ground Hereford 2m3f second in debuted cheekpieces (retained), albeit beaten 21l; ground slower than good would ask a new question.

runners_data.name: Beorma
runners_data.note: Transformed by tongue-tie addition, won twice recently including two nights ago at Southwell
runners_data.comment: Hosed up back over hurdles yesterday and looks very well in under a penalty
runners_data.spotlight: Transformed by the tongue-tie, adding an admittedly poor 2m4f Southwell novice handicap hurdle two nights ago to last weekend's Worcester chase debut rout (2m, good); likely still well ahead of her mark, and just a case of whether a third race in a week or possibly softer ground find her out; also engaged 8:30 Warwick Wednesday.

runners_data.name: Bowling Shane
runners_data.note: Closer who improved markedly when stepping up in trip at Ffos Las last month
runners_data.comment: Jumped better when third on Ffos Las handicap debut latest; step up from 2m may suit.
runners_data.spotlight: Better round of jumping inspired a major uplift on last month's handicap debut at Ffos Las (2m, good), shaping as if this longer trip might give him more chance of defying a still ungenerous-looking mark.

races.paceDynamic: Pepite De Saphir will likely take them along from the front with The Padster and Beorma close up, but none are particularly keen pace forcers which should create a moderate tempo early. The prominent duo may not apply serious pressure until turning for home, allowing the large contingent of hold-up horses to remain competitive. With seven of nine runners preferring to come from behind, including in-form Beorma and last-start winner Brionywells, the sustainable pace will strongly favour those who can quicken late. This race shape clearly benefits horses with finishing kicks over those needing things to fall apart up front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Pepite De Saphir leads without serious early pressure and the pace stays reasonable throughout
scenarios.body: The large hold-up contingent gets perfect conditions to unleash their finishing kicks, with Beorma's recent tongue-tie transformation and Brionywells' career-best Worcester form making them prime beneficiaries. Late-running types can pick off the moderate pace-setters in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If Pepite De Saphir and The Padster go too slow early then quicken sharply from the home turn
scenarios.body: The prominent pair open up a decisive advantage before the closers can respond effectively, with Beorma's recent wins showing he can also travel prominently when needed. The hold-up horses find themselves with too much ground to make up despite the moderate early pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders crawl along then stop to a walk turning for home
scenarios.body: The entire field bunches up entering the straight creating a sprint finish where the best handicapped horses prevail regardless of running style. Brionywells' career-best form and Saxon Cross's handy mark become decisive factors in a blanket finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Early Battle
scenarios.trigger: If The Padster or Beorma challenge Pepite De Saphir for the early lead creating unexpected pace
scenarios.body: The strong gallop sets up perfectly for the most patient hold-up horses who can produce the biggest late surges, while the pace-setters pay for their early exertions. The Best Way and Saxon Cross benefit most from the enhanced pace scenario.

watchPoints.text: Beorma running just two days ago at Southwell could leave him vulnerable despite his recent purple patch
The Padster may struggle if the going rides any slower than good given his preference for faster surfaces
Pepite De Saphir's early pace-setting role is crucial but he showed little when debuting the tongue-tie last month
Bells Of Ufford faces a significant fitness test after 70 days off despite his attractive handicap mark
Brionywells' rapid return after career-best Worcester win suggests connections are confident about his wellbeing

races.name: Turf Services Handicap Chase (ARC Summer Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Immortal Fame
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who won here over this trip previously but faces excuses from recent disappointing efforts and needs to prove his current wellbeing.
runners_data.comment: 2m4f winner here over both hurdles and fences; possible excuses on his last two starts.
runners_data.spotlight: 2m4f winner here over hurdles and fences with a little give underfoot, and possible excuses on both starts since his most recent success elsewhere (holding ground, pace battle); remains above any winning mark.

runners_data.name: Yes Indeed
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the likely pace scenario though must demonstrate that cheekpieces haven't had a negative impact on his jumping confidence.
runners_data.comment: Close fourth in this two years ago; weighted to strike, but ran below par last time.
runners_data.spotlight: Respectable efforts on both previous course visits, including a close fourth in this in 2024; weighted to strike, but must prove that the effects of the cheekpieces aren't on the wane after a sub-par latest effort.

runners_data.name: Karnaval Point
runners_data.note: Prominent racer perfectly positioned tactically with David Pipe's 5lb claimer taking off valuable weight after an impressive British debut success.
runners_data.comment: Up 9lb for cosy British/stable debut win (2m4f, good); won't mind longer trip or any rain.
runners_data.spotlight: Not hard pushed to score on last month's stable/British debut in a 2m4f Worcester handicap chase (good), for which a 9lb rise isn't harsh; French chase winner at up to 2m7f on slow ground, so appears to have an answer for most eventualities; player.

runners_data.name: Joltin N Jiving
runners_data.note: Natural leader who found the front-running key to recent improvement but Donald McCain's poor 14-day record raises trainer form concerns.
runners_data.comment: Back on track with last time's Doncaster hurdles second (2m5f); tongue-tie retained.
runners_data.spotlight: Resumed previous progression with last time's Doncaster handicap hurdle second (2m5f, good to soft) off 1lb lower; switched to front-running there, and would likely face competition for the lead if that strategy is persisted with today; retains tongue-tie for chasing debut.

runners_data.name: Tyson
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs a strong pace to close into and benefits from a significant 10lb weight advantage following his class drop.
runners_data.comment: Carries 7lb penalty for comfortable 2m4f win nine days ago; tries a new trip; big player
runners_data.spotlight: Newcastle and (latest) Huntingdon 2m4f class 5 hurdles winner either side of a stiffer task in a class 2; 10lb well in following the latter, but this Flat-bred didn't offer much in a moderate Sligo beginners' event on his sole previous chase start; 2nd at Warwick last night.

runners_data.name: Wheresmemoneygone
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from a 76-day break after making all last time and faces the challenge of conceding a 7lb weight rise.
runners_data.comment: Broke 2m5f course record when making all at Taunton; faces possible pace rivalry here.
runners_data.spotlight: Made all in debuted cheekpieces at Taunton in February (2m5f, good to soft); 7lb rise for posting that course record time was fair, and the subsequent Newbury defeat instead looked owed to the same sort of fight for the early lead which Joltin N Jiving might yet give him here.

races.paceDynamic: Joltin N Jiving will take them along from the front having switched to successful front-running tactics last time, with no obvious pace rival to challenge his lead early. The prominent runners Yes Indeed, Immortal Fame, Karnaval Point and Wheresmemoneygone will track within striking distance, while Tyson sits further back as the sole hold-up performer. With only one confirmed leader and no early pace pressure, this sets up as a sustainable gallop that will produce a sprint finish from the final half-mile. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers who can track the lone leader and strike when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays manageable and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The tracking prominent runners get the perfect tactical setup to close down Joltin N Jiving when the tempo increases. Karnaval Point or Yes Indeed benefit most from this patient stalking scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Joltin N Jiving builds an unassailable lead and stays on strongly
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets soft fractions early and has enough in reserve to resist late challenges up the hill. His switch to front-running tactics proves the key to unlocking his best form over fences.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly steady and develops into a staying test
scenarios.body: Tyson's hold-up style works perfectly as the early pace becomes pedestrian and he can unleash his finishing kick. The class drop and light weight combination proves decisive for the Skelton team.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Joltin N Jiving goes too slow early and gets swamped by the field
scenarios.body: The leader fails to establish a proper rhythm and multiple horses converge simultaneously in a messy finish. The race becomes a lottery where any of the prominent racers could emerge victorious.

watchPoints.text: Joltin N Jiving could set fractions too slow early and get overwhelmed by the tracking pack if he doesn't establish proper rhythm.
Yes Indeed's jumping confidence after wearing cheekpieces - any mistakes could derail his chances given the competitive field behind.
Karnaval Point's 5lb claiming jockey Rian Corcoran handling the pressure of this better class after their recent Worcester success together.
Tyson needs genuine pace to close into from his hold-up position - if the race becomes tactical he may struggle to land a blow.
Track Wheresmemoneygone's early position as he may need to be closer to the pace than usual given his 76-day absence.

races.name: Quinnbet Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Lively Citizen
runners_data.note: Natural leader whose 11-year-old legs may struggle to sustain gallop up Uttoxeter's demanding hill finish
runners_data.spotlight: Long in the tooth and no longer the force of old but arguably ran better than bare form suggests when weakening fifth at Aintree (2m1f, good) three weeks ago, and this race is less competitive; could have a say.

runners_data.name: Zucayan
runners_data.note: Strong traveller whose three Ludlow wins suggest he handles undulating tracks well, 25 days off ideal preparation
runners_data.comment: Ran well at favourite track Ludlow last month, after a break; may not be as good here
runners_data.spotlight: Gained all three hurdle wins at Ludlow; kept on for second behind progressive rival there (2m, good) last month, after a break, but may not be ideally suited by this switch to a left-handed track.

runners_data.name: Justus
runners_data.note: Prominent racer showing return to form at Hexham, low weight of 156lbs significant advantage in handicap
runners_data.comment: Seemed to have turned a corner when second off much-reduced mark at Hexham last month
runners_data.spotlight: Out of form last season but seemed to have turned a corner when second off much-reduced mark at Hexham (2m, good) 16 days ago; player if in similar mood again here.

runners_data.name: Genbu
runners_data.note: Course winner last month now 4lb higher but proven ability to handle Uttoxeter's unique demands
runners_data.comment: Came good for Sarah-Jayne Davies at third attempt, making all over C&D in May; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Came good for Sarah-Jayne Davies at third attempt, holding on well to make all over C&D (good) last month; 4lb higher now but won't mind if there's rain about; respected in current form.

runners_data.name: Ask A Sainte
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with scope for improvement in handicaps, Sean Bowen's 10lb claim reduces burden to 154lbs effective
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed 6yo who kept on from the rear for encouraging fourth behind Genbu over C&D (good) on last month's stable/handicap debut; probably still has a bigger run in him and features prominently in calculations.

runners_data.name: Calibos
runners_data.note: Dual-purpose performer whose hurdles form suggests improvement likely, prominent style suits if pace honest
runners_data.spotlight: Fair on the Flat at around 1m2f for the Kublers last year; safely held when making the frame on both hurdling starts for Jo Davis this year but improvement is possible on this handicap hurdle debut.

runners_data.name: Clever Relation
runners_data.note: 462 days absent makes this a fact-finding mission rather than serious winning chance
runners_data.comment: Makes stable/handicap debut after long absence; considered only if lively in betting
runners_data.spotlight: Won on the Flat for Hughie Morrison in 2024 but was soundly beaten at triple-digit odds in three novice hurdles for Sheila Lewis in 2024-25 season; makes stable/handicap hurdle debut after 462-day absence; could be considered only if lively in the betting.

races.paceDynamic: Lively Citizen will lead from the start with Justus and Calibos likely to track in prominent positions, creating a moderate early gallop that shouldn't be overly taxing. The lack of confirmed front-runners beyond Lively Citizen means the pace will be sustainable through the early stages, allowing hold-up horses like Zucayan, Ask A Sainte and Genbu to get into contention. With several prominent racers likely to press forward, the pace will quicken from the second-last hurdle creating a strong finish. This measured early tempo followed by acceleration strongly favours hold-up horses and those that can produce their best effort late in the race.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate through halfway and quickens late
scenarios.body: The sustainable early gallop allows patient riders to position their mounts perfectly before unleashing finishing kicks up the hill. Zucayan and Ask A Sainte benefit most from being able to use their natural finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Justus and Calibos press Lively Citizen creating honest pace throughout
scenarios.body: The even gallop suits horses that can travel strongly in behind the leaders and kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized. Justus's recent return to form and Calibos's improvement curve position them perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominates late
scenarios.trigger: If Lively Citizen gets easy lead and kicks clear from two out
scenarios.body: The veteran's class tells as he gets ideal conditions to use his experience, with the field unable to reel him back despite his advancing years. His prominent style becomes effective front-running.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Genbu repeats C&D victory
scenarios.trigger: If early pace collapses into sprint finish up the hill
scenarios.body: The course winner's knowledge of the track and ability to quicken off slow pace gives him the edge in a tactical finish. His previous success here under similar conditions proves decisive.

watchPoints.text: Lively Citizen's jumping under pressure - any mistakes when challenged will end his chances quickly
Early pace development between Justus and Calibos - if they go too hard it opens door for hold-up horses
Ask A Sainte's position turning for home - needs to be within striking distance to use finishing kick
Zucayan's jumping rhythm early - needs clean passage to deliver his customary strong finish
Weather conditions pre-race - any rain would significantly boost Genbu's chances on softer ground
